role.en: Jewish preacher; central figure of Christianity
role.zh: 犹太传道者，基督教的核心人物

summary.en: A Jewish teacher from Galilee whose preaching and reported healings drew followers in Roman-ruled Judaea and Galilee. He was crucified in Jerusalem under the prefect Pontius Pilate; his followers proclaimed his resurrection, and Christians venerate him as the Messiah and Son of God.
summary.zh: 来自加利利的犹太导师，其传道和所传的医治神迹在罗马治下的犹地亚和加利利吸引了众多追随者。他在总督本丢·彼拉多治下于耶路撒冷被钉十字架；门徒宣告他复活，基督徒尊他为弥赛亚和神之子。

label.zh: 伯利恒（据福音书所载出生地）
在耶路撒冷被钉十字架

sources.title: E. P. Sanders, The Historical Figure of Jesus (1993)

note: Birth c. 6–4 BCE and death c. 30 or 33 CE are scholarly estimates; the dates of ministry stops are approximate.

summary.en: A Greek-speaking Jew from Tarsus who persecuted the early followers of Jesus until a vision on the road to Damascus. He became the most influential missionary of early Christianity, founding churches across Anatolia and Greece; his letters form much of the New Testament.
summary.zh: 出身塔尔苏斯、讲希腊语的犹太人，曾迫害耶稣早期追随者，直到在前往大马士革途中见到异象。他成为早期基督教最具影响力的传教士，在安纳托利亚和希腊建立众多教会，其书信构成《新约》的重要部分。

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Saint Paul the Apostle
New Testament, Acts of the Apostles and Pauline letters

note: Birth c. 5 and death c. 64–67 (Wikidata: 66) are approximate; journey dates follow conventional chronology.

summary.en: Widow of Odaenathus, she ruled Palmyra as regent for her son Vaballathus and, as Roman power faltered, seized Egypt and much of the eastern Roman Empire. Emperor Aurelian defeated her armies at Antioch and Emesa in 272 and took her captive.
summary.zh: 奥登纳图斯的遗孀，以儿子瓦巴拉图斯摄政的身份统治帕尔米拉，并趁罗马衰弱夺取埃及和东部大片领土。272年奥勒良皇帝在安条克和埃梅萨击败其军队并将她俘虏。

label.en: Paraded in Aurelian's triumph in Rome
label.zh: 在罗马奥勒良的凯旋式上示众

note: Birth c. 240 and death after 274 are uncertain; ancient accounts of her fate differ.

summary.en: Son of Ardashir I and second Sasanian shah. He defeated three Roman emperors—Gordian III, Philip the Arab and Valerian, whom he captured at Edessa—and recorded his deeds at Naqsh-e Rostam. He tolerated religious diversity and gave early support to the prophet Mani.
summary.zh: 阿尔达希尔一世之子，萨珊王朝第二代君主。他先后战胜三位罗马皇帝——戈尔迪安三世、阿拉伯人菲利普和在埃德萨被俘的瓦勒良，并在纳克什-鲁斯塔姆铭刻功业。他宽容多元宗教，曾支持先知摩尼。

label.en: Victory at Misiche over Gordian III
label.zh: 在米西刻战胜戈尔迪安三世

note: Wikidata gives birth as 300, which conflicts with his reign from 240; c. 215 follows standard accounts. Death 270 (Iranica) or 272 (Wikidata, Britannica); 272 used. Stop dates approximate.

summary.en: Remembered as Anushirvan ("of the immortal soul"), he reformed Sasanian taxation and the army, suppressed the Mazdakite movement and patronised learning. He sacked Antioch in 540, made the Fifty Years' Peace with Byzantium and extended Persian power to Yemen.
summary.zh: 号称“阿努希尔万”（不朽灵魂），他改革萨珊税制和军制，镇压马兹达克运动并奖掖学术。540年洗劫安条克，与拜占庭订立“五十年和约”，并将波斯势力扩展至也门。

sources.title: Procopius, History of the Wars, Books I–II

note: Birth year c. 501 and the Yemen expedition date (c. 570) are approximate.

summary.en: Born in Mecca, he began preaching around 610, proclaiming the revelations later collected as the Qur'an. Persecuted in Mecca, he migrated to Medina in 622, where he led the Muslim community, and by his death in 632 had united much of Arabia under Islam.
summary.zh: 生于麦加，约610年开始传布后来汇编为《古兰经》的启示。在麦加受迫害后于622年迁往麦地那，领导穆斯林社团；至632年去世时，阿拉伯半岛大部已在伊斯兰旗帜下统一。

sources.title: Ibn Ishaq, Sirat Rasul Allah (trans. Guillaume)

note: Birth year traditional (c. 570; Wikidata 571).

role.en: Fourth Rashidun caliph; first Shia Imam
role.zh: 第四任正统哈里发、什叶派第一任伊玛目

summary.en: Cousin and son-in-law of Muhammad and one of the first to accept Islam. He became the fourth caliph in 656 amid civil strife, fought at the Camel and Siffin, moved his capital to Kufa and was assassinated there in 661. Shia Muslims regard him as the Prophet's rightful successor.
summary.zh: 穆罕默德的堂弟和女婿，最早皈依伊斯兰教者之一。656年在内乱中继任第四任哈里发，经历骆驼之战和隋芬之战，迁都库法，661年在那里遇刺。什叶派穆斯林视他为先知的合法继承人。

label.en: Battle of the Camel near Basra
label.zh: 巴士拉附近的骆驼之战

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica: ʿAli b. Abi Taleb

note: Birth c. 599/600 (Wikidata 599).

role.zh: 阿拔斯王朝第五任哈里发

summary.en: Caliph from 786 to 809, his reign is remembered as a high point of Abbasid wealth and culture, later romanticised in the Thousand and One Nights. He campaigned against Byzantium, ruled for years from Raqqa, and died in Khorasan while suppressing a revolt.
summary.zh: 786—809年在位，其统治被视为阿拔斯王朝财富与文化的鼎盛时期，后来在《一千零一夜》中被浪漫化。他多次征讨拜占庭，曾长期驻跸拉卡，在呼罗珊平叛途中去世。

label.zh: 攻取安纳托利亚的赫拉克利亚

label.en: Dies at Tus; buried near today's Mashhad
label.zh: 卒于图斯，葬于今马什哈德

summary.en: A scholar of Khwarazmian origin who worked in Abbasid Baghdad under al-Ma'mun. His book on al-jabr gave algebra its name, and his treatise on Hindu numerals spread decimal place-value arithmetic; the word "algorithm" derives from his name.
summary.zh: 祖籍花剌子模的学者，在马蒙治下的阿拔斯首都巴格达工作。他关于“还原与对消”的著作使“代数”得名，其论印度数字的著作传播了十进位值制算术；“算法”一词即源于他的名字。

label.zh: 在巴格达加入马蒙的学者群

sources.title: R. Rashed, Al-Khwarizmi: The Beginnings of Algebra (2009)

note: Birth (c. 780) and death (c. 850) are approximate; birthplace uncertain.

summary.en: A landowner from near Tus in Khorasan who spent some thirty years composing the Shahnameh, the Persian national epic. Tradition says he presented it to Mahmud of Ghazni and was poorly rewarded; he died in Tus, where his tomb stands.
summary.zh: 呼罗珊图斯附近的地主，历时约三十年写成波斯民族史诗《列王纪》。相传他将作品献给伽色尼的马哈茂德而未获厚赏；他卒于图斯，陵墓至今犹存。

note: Birth c. 940 and death 1019–1025 are uncertain; the Ghazni visit is traditional.

summary.en: A polymath from near Bukhara who served Samanid and later Buyid rulers as physician and vizier. His Canon of Medicine and Book of Healing became pillars of medicine and philosophy in the Islamic world and Latin Europe.
summary.zh: 出生于布哈拉附近的博学家，先后为萨曼王朝和布韦希王朝君主担任医生和大臣。他的《医典》和《治疗论》成为伊斯兰世界和拉丁欧洲医学与哲学的基石。

label.zh: 任萨曼王朝埃米尔的医生
在伊斯法罕卡库耶宫廷

summary.en: A Persian scholar who taught at the Nizamiyya madrasa in Baghdad, then abandoned his post in a spiritual crisis to live as a Sufi. His Revival of the Religious Sciences reconciled Sufism with Sunni orthodoxy, and his Incoherence of the Philosophers critiqued Aristotelian philosophy.
summary.zh: 波斯学者，曾执教巴格达尼扎米亚学院，后因精神危机辞职过苏非生活。他的《宗教学科的复兴》调和了苏非主义与逊尼正统，《哲学家的矛盾》批判了亚里士多德派哲学。

label.zh: 在内沙布尔师从朱韦尼
任巴格达尼扎米亚学院教授
离开巴格达前往大马士革

summary.en: Born in Nishapur, he wrote a treatise solving cubic equations geometrically and led the team that devised the Jalali solar calendar for Sultan Malik-Shah. Quatrains attributed to him became world-famous through Edward FitzGerald's 1859 translation.
summary.zh: 生于内沙布尔，著有以几何方法解三次方程的论著，并主持为苏丹马立克沙制定哲拉里太阳历。归于他名下的四行诗经爱德华·菲茨杰拉德1859年的英译而闻名世界。

label.zh: 撒马尔罕：撰写代数论著
在马立克沙的伊斯法罕天文台

note: Dates of the Samarkand and Merv stays are approximate.

role.en: Sultan of Egypt and Syria; founder of the Ayyubid dynasty
role.zh: 埃及和叙利亚苏丹，阿尤布王朝创立者

summary.en: A Kurdish commander born in Tikrit who rose in Zengid service, became vizier of Fatimid Egypt and then united Egypt and Syria under his rule. He destroyed the crusader army at Hattin in 1187 and retook Jerusalem, then held the Third Crusade to a negotiated truce.
summary.zh: 生于提克里特的库尔德将领，在赞吉王朝效力中崛起，任法蒂玛埃及的维齐尔，后将埃及和叙利亚统一于自己治下。1187年在哈丁歼灭十字军并收复耶路撒冷，又迫使第三次十字军以和约收场。

sources.title: Baha al-Din Ibn Shaddad, The Rare and Excellent History of Saladin

summary.en: Crowned co-ruler by her father George III and sole monarch from 1184, Tamar presided over the height of medieval Georgia's power and culture. Her armies defeated Muslim coalitions at Shamkor and Basiani, and she helped found the Empire of Trebizond. The Georgian Orthodox Church venerates her as a saint.
summary.zh: 由父王格奥尔基三世立为共治者，1184年起独立执政，塔玛尔统治时期是中世纪格鲁吉亚国力与文化的巅峰。其军队在沙姆科尔和巴西亚尼击败穆斯林联军，她还扶助建立了特拉比松帝国。格鲁吉亚东正教会尊她为圣人。

label.zh: 扶助建立特拉比松帝国
去世；传统上与格拉特修道院相关

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Tamara, queen of Georgia
Kartlis Tskhovreba: The Histories and Eulogies of the Sovereigns

note: Birth c. 1160–1166; her burial place is unknown; Basiani is often dated 1202 or 1205.

summary.en: Born in the Balkh region, he migrated with his family ahead of the Mongol invasions and settled in Seljuk Konya. His meeting with the dervish Shams of Tabriz transformed him into an ecstatic poet; his Masnavi is a masterpiece of Persian literature, and his followers formed the Mevlevi order.
summary.zh: 生于巴尔赫一带，蒙古入侵前随家人西迁，定居塞尔柱王朝的科尼亚。与托钵僧大不里士的沙姆斯相遇使他成为一位狂喜的诗人；其《玛斯纳维》是波斯文学杰作，门徒形成了梅夫拉维教团。

label.zh: 结识大不里士的沙姆斯

sources.title: F. D. Lewis, Rumi: Past and Present, East and West (2000)

note: Birthplace (Balkh or Vakhsh) and the dates of early migrations are debated.

summary.en: Sultan briefly from 1444 and again from 1451, he conquered Constantinople in 1453 and made it the Ottoman capital. He went on to annex Serbia, the Morea and the Empire of Trebizond and defeated the Aq Qoyunlu, turning the Ottoman state into an empire straddling Europe and Asia.
summary.zh: 1444年短暂在位，1451年再次即位，1453年攻克君士坦丁堡并定为奥斯曼首都。此后吞并塞尔维亚、摩里亚和特拉比松帝国，击败白羊王朝，使奥斯曼国家成为横跨欧亚的帝国。

label.zh: 在奥特鲁克贝利击败乌宗·哈桑

sources.title: F. Babinger, Mehmed the Conqueror and His Time (1978)

summary.en: Hereditary head of the Safavid Sufi order of Ardabil, he emerged from hiding at Lahijan with Qizilbash supporters, took Tabriz and was crowned shah in 1501. He imposed Twelver Shi'ism on Iran, defeated the Uzbeks at Merv, but lost to the Ottomans at Chaldiran in 1514.
summary.zh: 阿尔达比勒萨法维苏非教团的世袭首领，在拉希詹隐匿多年后率红头军起兵，1501年攻占大不里士称沙阿。他在伊朗推行十二伊玛目什叶派，在梅尔夫击败乌兹别克人，但1514年在查尔迪兰败于奥斯曼。

summary.en: The longest-reigning Ottoman sultan (1520–1566), known to Ottomans as Kanuni, "the Lawgiver". He took Belgrade, Rhodes and Baghdad, crushed Hungary at Mohács and besieged Vienna, while his reign saw a flowering of law, architecture and letters.
summary.zh: 在位时间最长的奥斯曼苏丹（1520—1566年），奥斯曼人称其为“立法者”。他攻取贝尔格莱德、罗得岛和巴格达，在摩哈赤大败匈牙利并围攻维也纳；其在位期间法律、建筑和文学均极为繁荣。

label.en: Dies at the siege of Szigetvár

name.zh: 阿拔斯一世（阿拔斯大帝）

summary.en: Coming to power in 1588 amid civil war, he rebuilt Safavid power with a standing army of slave soldiers and musketeers, recovered Tabriz and Baghdad from the Ottomans and Hormuz from the Portuguese, and made Isfahan a splendid capital.
summary.zh: 1588年在内乱中掌权，他以奴隶兵和火枪手组建常备军重振萨法维国力，从奥斯曼手中收复大不里士和巴格达，从葡萄牙人手中夺回霍尔木兹，并把伊斯法罕建成辉煌的首都。

label.zh: 从葡萄牙人手中夺取霍尔木兹

note: Baghdad fell to Abbas in January 1624 (siege began 1623).

role.en: Shah of Iran; founder of the Afsharid dynasty
role.zh: 伊朗沙阿，阿夫沙尔王朝创立者

summary.en: A soldier of the Afshar tribe of Khorasan who drove the Afghans and Ottomans out of Iran, deposed the last Safavids and was crowned on the Mughan plain in 1736. He sacked Delhi in 1739, but his harsh rule ended when his own officers assassinated him.
summary.zh: 呼罗珊阿夫沙尔部落出身的军人，将阿富汗人和奥斯曼人逐出伊朗，废黜萨法维末代君主，1736年在穆甘草原加冕。1739年洗劫德里，但统治严酷，最终被自己的军官刺杀。

label.zh: 生于呼罗珊达斯特格尔德
在达姆甘击败阿富汗人

sources.title: M. Axworthy, The Sword of Persia (2006)

name.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克

role.en: Founder and first president of the Republic of Turkey
role.zh: 土耳其共和国缔造者和首任总统

summary.en: An Ottoman officer who distinguished himself at Gallipoli and led the Turkish national movement from Anatolia after 1919. Victorious in the War of Independence, he founded the Republic in 1923 and imposed sweeping secular, legal and alphabet reforms.
summary.zh: 奥斯曼军官，在加里波利战役中崭露头角，1919年后在安纳托利亚领导土耳其民族运动。独立战争胜利后，他于1923年建立共和国，推行全面的世俗化、法律和文字改革。

label.zh: 卒于伊斯坦布尔多尔玛巴赫切宫

note: Born 1881; his exact birthdate is not recorded.

role.zh: 旅行家、考古学家、殖民官员

summary.en: An English traveller and archaeologist who explored Syria, Mesopotamia and Arabia before World War I. Recruited to British intelligence in Cairo and Basra, she became Oriental Secretary in Baghdad, helped draw the borders of Iraq and install Faisal I as king, and founded the Iraq Museum.
summary.zh: 英国旅行家和考古学家，一战前游历叙利亚、美索不达米亚和阿拉伯半岛。战时被英国情报部门派驻开罗和巴士拉，后任巴格达东方事务秘书，参与划定伊拉克边界、扶立费萨尔一世为国王，并创建伊拉克博物馆。

sources.title: G. Howell, Daughter of the Desert: The Remarkable Life of Gertrude Bell (2006)

role.zh: 苏菲派神秘主义者、诗人

summary.en: Born into poverty in Basra and, by tradition, sold into slavery before being freed, Rabi'a became a celebrated ascetic. She taught that God should be loved for His own sake, not from fear of hell or hope of paradise, a doctrine of divine love central to later Sufism.
summary.zh: 拉比雅生于巴士拉的贫寒之家，据传曾被卖为奴，后获自由，成为著名的苦行者。她主张爱真主应出于真主本身，而非畏惧火狱或渴望天园，这种神爱学说成为后世苏菲主义的核心。

sources.title: Margaret Smith, Rabi'a the Mystic and Her Fellow-Saints in Islam (1928)

note: Her biography is known mainly from later hagiography (Attar); birth dates of 714, 717 and 718 are given. A tomb on the Mount of Olives attributed to her belongs to a different woman.

summary.en: Chief engineer to the Artuqid rulers of Diyarbakır, al-Jazari completed in 1206 his Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices, describing water clocks, automata, pumps and a water-raising machine driven by a crank, with careful construction drawings.
summary.zh: 加扎利是迪亚巴克尔阿尔图格王朝统治者的首席工程师，1206年完成《精巧机械装置知识之书》，书中以精细的制图描述了水钟、自动机、水泵以及由曲柄驱动的提水机械。

label.zh: 生于伊本·欧麦尔岛（吉兹雷）
在迪亚巴克尔为阿尔图格王朝效力

label.en: Completes his book of mechanical devices

sources.title: Donald R. Hill (trans.), The Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices (1974)

note: Birth year is inferred from his statement of 25 years in Artuqid service; 1206 is the date of the book, and his death is usually placed in the same year.

summary.en: A local ruler from Pars who rebelled against his Parthian overlord, killed Artabanus IV at Hormozgan in 224 and was crowned King of Kings of Iran. He centralised power, patronised Zoroastrian priests and began the long wars with Rome.
summary.zh: 出身法尔斯的地方统治者，起兵反抗安息宗主，224年在霍尔木兹甘杀死阿尔达班四世，加冕为“伊朗万王之王”。他加强中央集权，扶持琐罗亚斯德教祭司，并开启了与罗马的长期战争。

label.zh: 生于法尔斯（伊斯塔赫尔一带）
建阿尔达希尔-花拉（菲鲁扎巴德）
在霍尔木兹甘击败阿尔达班四世

note: Birth year and early career stops follow later tradition (Kārnāmag, al-Tabari); Hatra fell c. 240–241.

summary.en: Raised in a Jewish-Christian baptist sect in Babylonia, Mani proclaimed a universal religion of light and darkness that he wrote down himself. Shapur I let him preach across the empire; under Bahram I he died in prison, but his church spread from Roman Africa to China.
summary.zh: 摩尼在巴比伦尼亚一个犹太-基督教浸礼派团体中长大，宣讲以光明与黑暗二元为核心的普世宗教，并亲自撰写经典。沙普尔一世允许他在帝国各地传教；他在巴赫拉姆一世时死于狱中，但其教会从罗马北非一直传播到中国。

label.zh: 生于泰西封附近（巴比伦尼亚马尔迪努）

label.en: Begins preaching after his second revelation
label.zh: 第二次启示后开始传教

label.en: Mission to the Indus lands (Turan, Sindh)
label.zh: 赴印度河流域传教（图兰、信德）

label.en: At Shapur I's court; dedicates the Shabuhragan
label.zh: 入沙普尔一世宫廷，献上《沙卜拉干》
死于贡德沙普尔（贝拉帕特）狱中

sources.title: S. N. C. Lieu, Manichaeism in the Later Roman Empire and Medieval China (2nd ed., 1992)

note: His death is dated 274 or 276/277 depending on the chronology of Bahram I’s reign.

role.en: Monk, creator of the Armenian alphabet
role.zh: 修士，亚美尼亚字母创制者

summary.en: A former royal secretary turned missionary monk who, with Catholicos Sahak and King Vramshapuh, devised the 36-letter Armenian alphabet around 405, then had the Bible translated. Armenians venerate him as a saint; Georgian and Caucasian Albanian scripts are also attributed to him by tradition.
summary.zh: 曾任王室文书、后为传教修士。约405年他在大公教长萨哈克和国王弗拉姆沙普赫支持下创制了36个字母的亚美尼亚文字，随后主持翻译《圣经》。亚美尼亚人尊他为圣徒；传统上格鲁吉亚文和高加索阿尔巴尼亚文也被归于他的创制。

label.zh: 在瓦加尔沙帕特任王室文书

label.en: Seeks scripts and scholars in Edessa
label.zh: 在埃德萨寻访文字与学者

label.en: Letters given final form at Samosata

sources.title: Koriun, The Life of Mashtots (5th century)

note: Stops and dates follow his disciple Koriun’s Life; the alphabet is dated 405 by convention.

summary.en: A Meccan commander whose cavalry charge defeated the Muslims at Uhud before he converted around 629. Called "the Sword of God", he led the Ridda campaigns, the first invasion of Iraq and a famous desert march to Syria, and commanded at the Yarmouk.
summary.zh: 麦加将领，曾在伍侯德之战以骑兵突击击败穆斯林，约629年皈依伊斯兰教。他被称为“真主之剑”，领导了叛教战争和首次入侵伊拉克，率军穿越沙漠驰援叙利亚，并在雅尔穆克战役中指挥作战。

label.en: Leads the Meccan cavalry at Uhud
label.zh: 在伍侯德之战率麦加骑兵

label.en: Extracts the Muslim army at Mu'tah
label.zh: 在穆塔之战中保全穆斯林军队

label.en: Desert march to Syria; siege of Damascus
label.zh: 穿越沙漠进军叙利亚，围攻大马士革

sources.title: H. Kennedy, The Great Arab Conquests (2007)

note: Birth year approximate; some traditions place his death in Medina.

summary.en: An early convert and close companion of Muhammad who ruled as caliph from 634 to 644, the decade in which Arab armies took Syria, Iraq, Egypt and western Iran. He organised the diwan pay registers and the Hijri calendar, and was stabbed in the Medina mosque by a Persian slave.
summary.zh: 先知穆罕默德的早期皈依者和亲密伙伴，634–644年任哈里发；正是在这十年里，阿拉伯军队攻占了叙利亚、伊拉克、埃及和伊朗西部。他建立了“迪万”薪俸登记制度和希吉拉历，最终在麦地那清真寺被一名波斯奴隶刺杀。

sources.title: W. Madelung, The Succession to Muhammad (1997)

note: His conversion is dated c. 616 by tradition; the Jerusalem visit is variously placed in 637 or 638.

role.en: Wife of Muhammad; transmitter of hadith
role.zh: 穆罕默德之妻，圣训传述者

summary.en: Daughter of Abu Bakr and a wife of Muhammad, who died in her chamber in Medina. She became one of the most prolific transmitters of hadith and a political actor in her own right, leading the opposition to Ali at the Battle of the Camel in 656.
summary.zh: 阿布·伯克尔之女、先知穆罕默德的妻子，先知在她位于麦地那的居室中去世。她是传述圣训最多的人之一，也是独立的政治人物，656年在骆驼之战中领导反对阿里的阵营。

label.zh: 先知在她的居室中去世

label.en: Leads the forces at the Battle of the Camel, Basra
label.zh: 在巴士拉骆驼之战中领兵

sources.title: D. A. Spellberg, Politics, Gender, and the Islamic Past: The Legacy of ʿAʾisha bint Abi Bakr (1994)

note: Birth year is approximate (c. 613–614).

summary.en: Called "the philosopher of the Arabs", al-Kindi worked with the translators of Abbasid Baghdad to adapt Greek philosophy to Islamic thought. He wrote on optics, music, medicine and Indian numerals, and his treatise on deciphering messages is the earliest known description of frequency analysis.
summary.zh: 被称为“阿拉伯人的哲学家”，他与阿拔斯巴格达的翻译家合作，使希腊哲学与伊斯兰思想相调和。他的著述涉及光学、音乐、医学和印度数字，其关于破译密文的论著是已知最早描述频率分析的文献。

label.en: Joins the scholars of al-Ma'mun's Baghdad
label.zh: 加入马蒙治下巴格达的学者圈

label.en: Tutor to the son of caliph al-Mu'tasim
label.zh: 任哈里发穆阿台绥姆之子的老师

note: Birth and death dates are approximate (c. 800–870).

role.zh: 历史学家、《古兰经》注释家

summary.en: A scholar from Amol on the Caspian who travelled to Rayy, Baghdad, Syria and Egypt to collect reports, then settled in Baghdad. His History of Prophets and Kings and his vast Qur'an commentary preserved earlier sources and set the standard for later Islamic historiography.
summary.zh: 来自里海沿岸阿莫勒的学者，曾到雷伊、巴格达、叙利亚和埃及搜集传述，后定居巴格达。他的《历代先知和帝王史》与浩繁的《古兰经》注释保存了大量早期材料，成为后世伊斯兰史学的典范。

label.zh: 生于塔巴里斯坦的阿莫勒

sources.title: F. Rosenthal, General Introduction to The History of al-Ṭabarī, vol. 1 (1989)

note: Travel dates follow Rosenthal’s reconstruction and are approximate.

summary.en: Widely held to be the greatest classical Arabic poet. A Kufan of modest birth, he was jailed for leading a revolt in Syria, then wrote his finest panegyrics for Sayf al-Dawla in Aleppo before quarrelling his way through the courts of Egypt and Iran. Bandits killed him on the road to Baghdad.
summary.zh: 被普遍视为最伟大的古典阿拉伯诗人。他出身库法寒门，曾因在叙利亚领导叛乱而入狱，后在阿勒颇为赛福·道莱写下最出色的颂诗，此后辗转埃及和伊朗宫廷，屡与主人失和。他在前往巴格达途中被盗匪杀害。

label.en: Imprisoned at Homs after a revolt
label.zh: 起事失败后被囚于霍姆斯

label.en: Court poet of Sayf al-Dawla, Aleppo
label.zh: 在阿勒颇任赛福·道莱的宫廷诗人

label.en: At the court of Kafur in Fustat
label.zh: 在福斯塔特卡富尔宫廷

label.en: At the court of Adud al-Dawla, Shiraz
label.zh: 在设拉子阿杜德·道莱宫廷
在代尔阿古勒附近遇害

role.en: Founder of the Nizari Ismaili state
role.zh: 尼扎里伊斯玛仪派国家创建者

summary.en: A Twelver Shi'i from Qom who converted to Ismailism, studied in Fatimid Cairo and returned to Iran as a missionary. In 1090 he took the castle of Alamut by infiltration and ruled from it for 34 years, reportedly never leaving the fortress, while his followers held off Seljuk sieges.
summary.zh: 出生于库姆的十二伊玛目派信徒，后改宗伊斯玛仪派，曾在法蒂玛开罗求学，回到伊朗传教。1090年他靠渗透手段夺取阿拉穆特城堡，在此统治34年，据说从未离开要塞，追随者屡次击退塞尔柱人的围攻。

label.zh: 在雷伊改宗伊斯玛仪派

label.en: Returns to Isfahan as a missionary

sources.title: F. Daftary, The Ismāʿīlīs: Their History and Doctrines (2nd ed., 2007)

note: Born probably in the 1050s (Daftary); the date of 1037 sometimes given rests on no early source.

role.zh: 天文学家、数学家、哲学家

summary.en: A polymath from Tus who spent decades in the Ismaili fortresses before entering Hulagu's service when Alamut fell. He persuaded the Ilkhan to fund the Maragheh observatory, compiled the Ilkhanid astronomical tables and devised the "Tusi couple", later echoed in Copernicus.
summary.zh: 出身图斯的博学家，在伊斯玛仪派要塞中度过数十年，阿拉穆特陷落后转投旭烈兀。他说服伊利汗出资建立马拉盖天文台，编成《伊利汗天文表》，并提出“图西双轮”，后来在哥白尼的著作中也出现了类似构造。

label.en: Scholar at the Ismaili court of Alamut
label.zh: 在阿拉穆特的伊斯玛仪派宫廷任学者

label.en: Joins Hulagu at the fall of Alamut
label.zh: 阿拉穆特陷落时投奔旭烈兀

label.en: Dies in Baghdad; buried at Kadhimiya
label.zh: 卒于巴格达，葬于卡兹米耶

sources.title: F. J. Ragep, Naṣīr al-Dīn al-Ṭūsī's Memoir on Astronomy (1993)

summary.en: A Shirazi poet who studied at the Nizamiyya in Baghdad and spent long years wandering before returning home in the 1250s. His Bustan (1257) and Gulistan (1258), moral tales in verse and rhymed prose, became the core of Persian schooling for centuries.
summary.zh: 设拉子诗人，曾在巴格达尼扎米耶学院求学，漂泊多年后于1250年代返乡。他的《果园》（1257）和《蔷薇园》（1258）以诗歌和韵文讲述劝世故事，数百年来一直是波斯语教育的核心读本。

label.zh: 在巴格达尼扎米耶学院求学

label.en: Back in Shiraz; completes the Bustan

note: Birth year (c. 1210) and travels are reconstructed from his own often embellished anecdotes.

summary.en: Shams al-Din Hafez of Shiraz, master of the Persian ghazal, served and outlived a series of rulers of his city. His Divan blends love, wine and mystical longing; Persians still open it at random to read their fortune, and his tomb is a place of pilgrimage.
summary.zh: 设拉子的沙姆斯丁·哈菲兹是波斯抒情诗（加扎勒）的大师，先后侍奉并送走了多位统治设拉子的君主。他的《诗集》融合爱情、美酒与神秘渴慕；波斯人至今仍随手翻开它来占卜，他的陵墓也成为朝圣之地。

label.en: Poet at the court of Abu Ishaq Inju
label.zh: 在阿布·伊斯哈格·因朱宫廷作诗

note: Dates are approximate; he died in 1389 or 1390. The Yazd stay is mentioned in his own verse and dated only roughly.

summary.en: A Jewish-born physician from Hamadan who converted to Islam and became vizier to the Ilkhan Ghazan. Ghazan commissioned his Jami' al-tawarikh, a history of the Mongols and of the known world; Rashid built the Rab'-e Rashidi scholarly quarter at Tabriz before being executed on a charge of poisoning Öljeitü.
summary.zh: 出身哈马丹犹太家庭的医生，皈依伊斯兰教后成为伊利汗合赞的宰相。合赞命他编撰《史集》，记述蒙古人及已知世界的历史；他在大不里士建立了拉什德区学术园区，后被诬毒害完者都而遭处决。

label.en: Physician at the Ilkhanid court, Tabriz
label.zh: 在大不里士任伊利汗宫廷医生
在完者都新都苏丹尼耶
在大不里士附近被处决

role.en: Mamluk sultan of Egypt and Syria
role.zh: 埃及和叙利亚的马穆鲁克苏丹

summary.en: A Kipchak Turk sold as a slave soldier, Baybars helped defeat Louis IX at Mansurah and the Mongols at Ain Jalut, then murdered Sultan Qutuz and took the throne. He reinstalled an Abbasid caliph in Cairo and captured Antioch and Krak des Chevaliers from the crusaders.
summary.zh: 钦察突厥人，被卖为奴隶兵。他参与在曼苏拉击败路易九世、在阿音札鲁特击败蒙古军，随后弑杀苏丹忽都斯登上王位。他在开罗重立阿拔斯哈里发，并从十字军手中夺取安条克和骑士堡。

label.zh: 在曼苏拉迎战路易九世

label.en: Commands the vanguard at Ain Jalut
label.zh: 在阿音札鲁特指挥先锋

sources.title: P. Thorau, The Lion of Egypt: Sultan Baybars I and the Near East in the Thirteenth Century (1992)

note: Birth year c. 1223–1228 is approximate.

role.zh: 赞吉王朝叙利亚统治者

summary.en: Son of Zengi, he ruled Aleppo from 1146, took Damascus in 1154 and united Muslim Syria under a programme of jihad, madrasas and hospitals. He sent Shirkuh and Saladin to Egypt, ending the Fatimid caliphate, but died as Saladin grew independent.
summary.zh: 赞吉之子，1146年起统治阿勒颇，1154年夺取大马士革，以圣战、兴办经学院和医院为纲领统一了穆斯林叙利亚。他派希尔库赫和萨拉丁前往埃及，终结了法蒂玛哈里发国，但在萨拉丁日益自立时去世。

label.en: Kills Raymond of Antioch at Inab
label.zh: 在伊纳卜之战杀死安条克的雷蒙

sources.title: N. Elisséeff, Nūr ad-Dīn: un grand prince musulman de Syrie au temps des croisades (1967)

summary.en: A Turkmen frontier chief around Söğüt in Bithynia whose raids on Byzantine towns created the beylik named after him. His victory at Bapheus (1302) drew warriors to his banner; his son Orhan took Bursa, where Osman was buried.
summary.zh: 比提尼亚瑟于特一带的土库曼边境首领，他对拜占庭城镇的袭掠造就了以其名字命名的侯国。1302年巴菲乌斯之战的胜利吸引众多战士投奔；其子奥尔汗攻下布尔萨，并将奥斯曼安葬于此。

label.en: Defeats a Byzantine army at Bapheus
label.zh: 在巴菲乌斯击败拜占庭军

sources.title: C. Kafadar, Between Two Worlds: The Construction of the Ottoman State (1995)

note: Almost everything about Osman comes from later Ottoman tradition; birth year is conventional and death c. 1323–1324 (some sources 1326).

summary.en: Selim "the Grim" deposed his father Bayezid II in 1512, crushed Shah Ismail at Chaldiran and in 1516–17 destroyed the Mamluk Sultanate, adding Syria, Egypt and the guardianship of Mecca and Medina to the empire and nearly doubling its size in eight years.
summary.zh: “冷酷者”塞利姆于1512年废黜父亲巴耶济德二世，在查尔迪兰大败伊斯玛仪沙，1516–1517年消灭马穆鲁克王朝，把叙利亚、埃及以及麦加、麦地那的守护权纳入帝国，八年间使疆域几乎扩大一倍。

label.zh: 在查尔迪兰击败伊斯玛仪一世

label.en: Defeats the Mamluks at Marj Dabiq
label.zh: 在达比克草原击败马穆鲁克

sources.title: H. İnalcık, The Ottoman Empire: The Classical Age 1300–1600 (1973)

role.en: Chief architect of the Ottoman Empire
role.zh: 奥斯曼帝国首席建筑师

summary.en: Born to a Christian family in a Cappadocian village and recruited through the devshirme, Sinan served as a janissary engineer before becoming chief imperial architect in 1538. Over fifty years he and his office built some 300 works, crowned by the Süleymaniye in Istanbul and the Selimiye in Edirne.
summary.zh: 出生于卡帕多细亚乡村的基督徒家庭，经“德夫希尔梅”征召入伍，曾任近卫军工程师，1538年成为帝国首席建筑师。五十年间他和他的建筑署建成约三百项工程，代表作是伊斯坦布尔的苏莱曼尼耶清真寺和埃迪尔内的塞利米耶清真寺。

label.zh: 生于开塞利附近的阿伊尔纳斯
被征召并在伊斯坦布尔受训
以近卫军身份参加查尔迪兰战役
建成苏莱曼尼耶清真寺
建成埃迪尔内塞利米耶清真寺

label.en: Dies in Istanbul; buried by the Süleymaniye
label.zh: 卒于伊斯坦布尔，葬于苏莱曼尼耶旁

sources.title: G. Necipoğlu, The Age of Sinan: Architectural Culture in the Ottoman Empire (2005)

note: Birth year c. 1488–1490.

summary.en: An Istanbul courtier who spent forty years travelling the Ottoman world and beyond and recorded it in the ten-volume Seyahatname ("Book of Travels"), a rich, often tall-tale-laden portrait of cities, languages, foods and customs from Vienna to Sudan.
summary.zh: 伊斯坦布尔的宫廷侍从，四十年间游历奥斯曼世界及更远之地，写成十卷本《游记》，以丰富、常带夸张的笔触描绘了从维也纳到苏丹的城市、语言、饮食与风俗。

label.en: With an Ottoman embassy in Vienna
label.zh: 随奥斯曼使团至维也纳

sources.title: R. Dankoff, An Ottoman Mentality: The World of Evliya Çelebi (2004)

note: His death date (c. 1682–1685) and place are uncertain.

summary.en: Crowned at sixteen over a kingdom paying tribute to the Seljuks, David rebuilt the army with Kipchak settlers, routed a Seljuk coalition at Didgori in 1121 and made Tbilisi his capital. He founded the Gelati monastery and academy, opening Georgia's golden age.
summary.zh: 十六岁继位时格鲁吉亚还在向塞尔柱人纳贡。大卫招募钦察移民重建军队，1121年在迪德戈里大败塞尔柱联军，并定都第比利斯。他创建格拉特修道院和学院，开启了格鲁吉亚的黄金时代。

label.zh: 十六岁继位（都城库塔伊西）

label.en: Takes Tbilisi and makes it the capital
label.zh: 夺取第比利斯并定为首都

sources.title: D. Rayfield, Edge of Empires: A History of Georgia (2012)

name.zh: 伊本·沙特（阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹）

summary.en: Exiled to Kuwait as a boy, Abdulaziz Al Saud retook Riyadh in a night raid in 1902 and over thirty years conquered Najd, al-Hasa, Hejaz and Asir. He proclaimed the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932, granted the oil concession that would transform it, and met Roosevelt in 1945.
summary.zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特少年时流亡科威特，1902年夜袭夺回利雅得，此后三十年间征服内志、哈萨、汉志和阿西尔。他于1932年宣布成立沙特阿拉伯王国，授予改变国家命运的石油特许权，并在1945年会见罗斯福。

label.en: Meets Roosevelt on USS Quincy, Great Bitter Lake
label.zh: 在大苦湖“昆西号”上会见罗斯福

sources.title: M. Al-Rasheed, A History of Saudi Arabia (2nd ed., 2010)

note: Birth year given as 1875 or 1876.

summary.en: A Qajar-born aristocrat and Swiss-trained lawyer who, as prime minister from 1951, nationalised the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company. A British-American-backed coup removed him in August 1953; he spent his last years under house arrest at his estate in Ahmadabad.
summary.zh: 出身恺加贵族、在瑞士获法学博士学位，1951年任首相后将英伊石油公司收归国有。1953年8月一场英美支持的政变推翻了他，晚年他在艾哈迈达巴德庄园遭软禁度过。

label.zh: 在纳沙泰尔获法学博士
出任首相，实行石油国有化

label.en: Defends Iran's case at the UN

label.zh: 在艾哈迈达巴德遭软禁

sources.title: E. Abrahamian, The Coup: 1953, the CIA, and the Roots of Modern U.S.–Iranian Relations (2013)

role.en: Cleric; founder of the Islamic Republic of Iran
role.zh: 宗教领袖，伊朗伊斯兰共和国创建者

summary.en: A Shi'i jurist from Khomein who taught in Qom and was exiled in 1964 for denouncing the Shah. From Najaf and then near Paris he led the opposition by cassette tape; he returned in February 1979 and ruled as Supreme Leader under his doctrine of guardianship of the jurist.
summary.zh: 出身霍梅因的什叶派法学家，在库姆讲学，1964年因抨击国王遭流放。他先后在纳杰夫和巴黎近郊通过录音磁带领导反对派，1979年2月回国，并依据“法学家监护”学说出任最高领袖。

label.zh: 被流放到土耳其布尔萨

sources.title: B. Moin, Khomeini: Life of the Ayatollah (1999)

summary.en: A Labour Zionist from Płońsk in Russian Poland who emigrated to Ottoman Palestine in 1906 and led the Jewish community's institutions under the British mandate. He proclaimed the State of Israel on 14 May 1948, led it through the war that followed, and retired to the Negev kibbutz of Sde Boker.
summary.zh: 出生于俄属波兰普翁斯克的劳工锡安主义者，1906年移居奥斯曼治下的巴勒斯坦，在英国委任统治时期领导犹太社团机构。1948年5月14日他宣布以色列建国，领导国家度过随后的战争，晚年退居内盖夫沙漠的斯代博克基布兹。

label.zh: 移居奥斯曼巴勒斯坦（佩塔提克瓦）

label.en: Expelled by the Ottomans; in New York
label.zh: 遭奥斯曼当局驱逐，前往纽约

label.en: Proclaims the State of Israel, Tel Aviv
label.zh: 在特拉维夫宣布以色列建国

sources.title: T. Segev, A State at Any Cost: The Life of David Ben-Gurion (2019)

role.en: Leader of the Arab Revolt; king of Syria and of Iraq
role.zh: 阿拉伯起义领袖，叙利亚国王、伊拉克国王

summary.en: Third son of Sharif Husayn of Mecca, Faisal led the Arab Revolt's northern army with T. E. Lawrence, entered Damascus in 1918 and pleaded for Arab independence in Paris. Crowned king of Syria in 1920, he was expelled by France within months; Britain made him king of Iraq in 1921.
summary.zh: 麦加谢里夫侯赛因的三子，与T. E. 劳伦斯一起率领阿拉伯起义的北路军，1918年进入大马士革，并在巴黎和会上为阿拉伯独立奔走。1920年加冕叙利亚国王，数月后即被法国驱逐；1921年英国立他为伊拉克国王。

label.en: Base at Aqaba after its capture
label.zh: 攻克亚喀巴后以此为基地

label.en: Proclaimed king of Syria; expelled after Maysalun
label.zh: 被拥立为叙利亚国王，梅萨隆之战后被逐

sources.title: A. A. Allawi, Faisal I of Iraq (2014)

summary.en: The most celebrated modern Iranian woman poet, whose frank collections from Captive (1955) to Another Birth (1964) broke taboos about female desire. Her documentary The House Is Black (1962), filmed in a leper colony near Tabriz, is a landmark of Iranian cinema. She died in a car crash at 32.
summary.zh: 伊朗最负盛名的现代女诗人，从《俘虏》（1955）到《新生》（1964），她的诗集坦率书写女性欲望，打破禁忌。她在大不里士附近麻风病院拍摄的纪录片《房子是黑的》（1962）是伊朗电影的里程碑。她在32岁时死于车祸。

label.en: Films The House Is Black near Tabriz
label.zh: 在大不里士附近拍摄《房子是黑的》

label.en: Dies in a car crash in Tehran

sources.title: F. Milani, Veils and Words: The Emerging Voices of Iranian Women Writers (1992)

summary.en: Sadr al-Din Shirazi, the leading philosopher of Safavid Iran, studied under Mir Damad in Isfahan, withdrew for years to a village near Qom, and taught in Shiraz. His "transcendent theosophy", with its doctrine of the primacy of existence, remains central to Shi'i philosophy.
summary.zh: 萨德尔丁·设拉兹是萨法维伊朗最重要的哲学家，曾在伊斯法罕师从米尔·达马德，在库姆附近的村庄隐居多年，后在设拉子讲学。他的“超越智慧”学说及其“存在优先”的主张至今仍是什叶派哲学的核心。
